The '''soundtrack''' of [[The Mandalorian Season Two|''The Mandalorian'' Season Two]] episodes "[[Chapter 13: The Jedi]]," "[[Chapter 14: The Tragedy]]," "[[Chapter 15: The Believer]]," and "[[Chapter 16: The Rescue]]" was released digitally on [[December 18]], [[2020]]. It was composed by [[Ludwig Göransson]].<ref name="LaughingPlace" />
